message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The cause was a column name mismatch. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`.

I didn't touch the migration. It's already applied in production and owned by the DBA team, so renaming the column there would have meant a production schema change.
